notes.title: News
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Sentinels,[/h2]

Starting tomorrow, our game will be available at a discount! We invite you to visit the world of our game, either alone or with friends.

We sincerely thank you for your patience and continuous support during this challenging time. Unfortunately, we have experienced [b]some losses[/b] within our team, and we are a bit smaller now, but despite this, we are still working hard to improve the game.

At the moment, we are focused on several important tasks:

[list]
[*]Code refactoring — to improve stability and enhance the game's performance.
[*]Bug fixing to make your gaming experience even better and more enjoyable.
[*]Voiceover localization for other languages, to make the game accessible to even more players worldwide.
[/list]
One of the reasons for the delay is our preparation for the [b]GDC event in San Francisco[/b] from March 15 to 21. This is a significant event that will open new opportunities for our project.

We are eagerly looking forward to the moment when we can present the demo of our new game to you and hear your valuable feedback. After returning from the exhibition, we will share with you the roadmap for the future development of the project.

[b]Thank you[/b] for staying with us during these difficult times for the entire gaming industry. We are confident that exciting joint projects and many remarkable achievements await us in the future!

Best wishes,

[b]~ Tracery of Fate Team ~[/b]

notes.title: Out of Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Difficult path[/h2]
Our small team has spent several years chasing our dream — to create a game that will touch the hearts of players. It was not an easy journey: economic challenges, sleepless nights of development, and the constant struggle to balance work, family, and the project.

At times, it felt like our dream would remain just an idea, but what kept us going was the belief that our world would find its audience. We became a family, learning to support one another, and every achievement — from a well-crafted model to the first positive feedback from testers — gave us the strength to move forward.

This is the result of our faith, hard work, and love. Thank you to everyone who stood by us. Our world is now open to you, and we hope it brings you the same emotions we experienced while creating it.

But this is not the end of Alfira's story. And there might be more ahead.

notes.title: Dev Diary 003
notes.content:
Within only a few days remaining until the release of [b]Tracery of Fate[/b], it feels like the right moment to pause and reflect on everything we’ve gone through to bring this project to life.

[h2]Final Touches[/h2]

We’re now at the stage where every little detail feels crucial. Testing is running around the clock, and though we strive for perfection, we know there may still be something we miss. We kindly ask for your understanding as we work swiftly to address any issues post-release.

It was vital for us to make the game accessible in multiple languages so players worldwide can immerse themselves in the story of this universe in their native tongue without missing a thing. We’ve also worked hard to enhance and expand multiplayer features, develop engaging puzzles, refine the combat system, and so much more. Whether you prefer to explore Alfira solo or with up to four friends, the choice is yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491378/32a824cde35ae21f7856ad05bf51937303d59a23.png[/img]
[h2]The Team’s Emotions[/h2]

Our team started small, and each member has made an extraordinary contribution to building this world. Over the last few months, the workload has intensified, but we all recognize this as our opportunity to prove ourselves. Everyone approaches the upcoming release differently—some are excited, others are nervous, and some are already looking toward the future. But we’re all united in one thing: this has been an incredible, arduous journey.

[h2]Alfira Comes Alive[/h2]

When we look at the world we’ve created, we're filled with mixed emotions. Alfira is a dark, complex, and dying world, and bringing it to life has required immense emotional investment from us. Yet, despite its somber tone, Alfira feels alive. You can see it in every corner of the map, in the characters’ dialogues, and in the intricate details of the environment.

The soundtrack deserves a special mention as well. It has become the binding thread that gives Alfira its unique atmosphere.

[h2]Players’ Expectations[/h2]

We know that players’ expectations are high, and that both inspires and intimidates us. Our hope is to immerse you in the mysteries of Alfira and evoke the emotions we’ve poured into every element of this game.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Of course, we’re not stopping after the release. We already have plans for the first major update and additional content. But for now, our top priority is ensuring a smooth launch.

Thank you to everyone who believed in us and supported us on this journey. Only a few days remain until [b]Tracery of Fate[/b] becomes available to everyone, and we sincerely hope the game evokes the same emotions in you that we felt while creating it.

See you in Alfira!

– The Tracery of Fate Development Team

notes.title: Dev Diary 002
notes.content:
[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
From the very beginning, we wanted to create a multiplayer game. We had to do some serious brainstorming to allow players to freely join the same adventure, regardless of their main progression.

[h3]Flexibility[/h3]
This is why we incorporated a flexible system for switching [b]active abilities[/b] and [b]passive skills[/b] within the game’s design, along with a shared gold resource and storage. Thanks to this, a player joining mid-game can still participate equally with others.

[h3]Difficulty[/h3]
In multiplayer mode, the difficulty increases as all enemies automatically scale their stats.

[h3]Revival[/h3]
Remember, in multiplayer mode, you can revive a fallen teammate by simply standing nearby for 5 seconds. Otherwise, after a limited time, they will return to the last Guardian’s House they visited.

[h3]Performance[/h3]
Since many calculations are processed on the host player’s computer, it makes sense to create the game session on the player with the most powerful hardware.

[h3]Gestures[/h3]
We utilized the Valve Index headset's API to implement gestures, expanding communication options for players.

[h3]Voice Communication[/h3]
Early in development, we made a strategic decision not to build voice chat directly into the game. As gamers ourselves, we’re long-time users of platforms like Discord and TeamSpeak. We know how high-quality and convenient they are.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
Up next is the Steam Scream Festival!

notes.title: Dev Diary 001
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

In the first part of our dev diary, we'd like to briefly introduce you to the world of our game and share a little bit about its story.

[h2]The Story[/h2]
In the grim world of Alfira, life is fading as it is torn apart by the Bane. A long-standing struggle against demons ended in their banishment, but the goddess Elfira, exhausted from battle, was unable to shield the world from the curse they left behind. Now, the Blight slowly consumes all living things, swallowing entire cities, devastating humans, elves, and orcs, and turning them into monsters. Only a few pockets of life, protected by the Stones of Life, still resist the dark force. However, the threat extends beyond just the curse. A former ally, the mad necromancer Margud, seeks to exploit Elfira's weakness and become the new god. He aims to transform all the living into the undead — beings that know no fear, no pain, and no doubt — to build an army to fight the Bane, which, in his view, the dead are immune to.

But you, the Sentinel, is the last hope for this world. Created by an ancient race to battle the demons, you were awakened in a time of need and became Elfira’s champion. The demons were defeated, but Margud betrayed the goddess and destroyed the Bastion — the Sentinels’ stronghold — turning most of them into his mindless servants, making them his generals. Only a few escaped this fate, sealed in sarcophagi, and now, years later, the goddess has managed to bring you back to life. Starting from scratch, with no memories, you embark on a journey, guided by Elfira's priestess, an orcish merchant, and the Spirit — a Sentinel who has lost his body but retained his memory.

As you regain your strength and combat skills, you will once again become a legendary warrior, wielding melee and ranged weapons, shields, and pistols. Along the way, you’ll collect artifacts infused with the goddess's power and restore the Bastion to stop Margud and free the captive Sentinels. This dying world is beautiful in its own way, and its story will unfold before you with every step you take on the path to salvation.

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]
In the next part of the diary, we'll explain how you can play solo or with friends, discussing the intricacies of cooperative gameplay and character progression. We will publish it before the Steam Scream.

[h2]Game News[/h2]
At the moment, our team is finishing up the translation of the game into other languages. We also wanted to inform you that after the Steam Halloween Festival, the price of the game will change, as we are nearing the final build for release. This is your last chance to purchase our game at the current price.

[i]Thank you for being with us! If you have any questions about how we developed the game or what’s in it, feel free to ask, and we’ll answer your questions in the next dev diary. [/i]

~~ Tracery of Fate Team ~~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491378/de1e3444fe1df7980a7aa0051c72466b05874162.jpg[/img]

We hope you will enjoy the game as soon as it becomes available.

Once again, thank you for your patience and dedication to our project!

[*]Developer diaries every two weeks. The first developer diary will be released on October 11, 2024.

[b]Sincerely, the development team.[/b]

notes.title: February announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491378/43f00bdca02fe42cafb41b42a1cb7c7878528581.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hello Sentinels[/h2]

We would like to [b]thank everyone[/b] for all your feedback. It was accumulated, stored and analyzed. This is how we ended up with all those changes that are [b]coming at 15th of February[/b] live.

The following update aims to [b]speed up[/b] your game. Literally. When [b]both your hands are free, you move faster[/b]. Escape or get to the right place in less time.

More ammo per clip and enhanced bullet damage will [b]increase your DPS[/b]. And decreased reloading time will push it even further.

[b]Active abilities streamlined[/b]. You will gain more outcome in fewer steps. Recover an artifact, assign ability to your weapon and boom! You can enable or disable it at any time in combat and [b]use it automatically[/b] as long as you have enough mana in your pool.

Yes, [b]Anger replaced with Mana[/b]. You just have it, spend it and it will replenish over time. You can increase your Health and Mana pool capacities, regeneration time and use potions for quick recovery.

[b]Passive skills unlimited[/b]. You will be able to pick any option you can afford. Take them all! There are no more restrictions of three only.

We are working on rebalance everything in our game. So there are [b]more changes to come[/b].

[b]Make sure you don't miss this update![/b]

[h3]Merry X-mas and a Happy New Year to everybody!🎄[/h3]
This update will bring some snow to the world of Alfira. The merchant Hazrit and the Priestess have changed their clothes. It looks like even undead skeletons are affected by these holidays. So they made snowmen!

[h3]Eastern Dungeon location🔥[/h3]
The activation of Stone of Life in the Lower Town will open the door to new Sentinel Stronghold. It is there you will find the path to the Eastern Dungeon. Built long ago by dwarven race it is partly ruined now.

[h3]New monsters🦌[/h3]
You are going to face multiple new monsters. Some of them have their own move-set and abilities. 
[list]
[*]Skeleton spearman
[*]Undead panther
[*]Skinless panther
[*]Small spider
[*]Cave spider
[/list]
[h3]New Relic and schematics🍪[/h3]
There are two new schematics are available now. They are [b]Freezing bullets[/b] and [b]Freezing mine[/b]. Find them, bring them back to the Merchant and try new consumables! The [b]Sickle of Death[/b] Relic will grant you [b]Shield Bash[/b] active ability upon receiving it to the Priestess.

[h3]New puzzle🛷[/h3]
You'll have to solve the puzzle with pressing plates to proceed the boss chamber.

[h3]New traps🎁[/h3]
Watch out for Pendulum blades and Crushing cone traps!

By the way, the root trap can no longer be triggered by projectile attacks.

[h3]New soundtracks🔔[/h3]
We've added several atmospheric ambient music soundtracks. Please let us know how do you like them.

[h3]The Big Boss⛄[/h3]
Previously available undead officers were just mini-bosses. Gorgolith bone golem is a massive abomination that will deliver you a full scale bossfight. You will have to use all your skill, right tactics and consumable items to bring this undead army officer down.

[h3]Achievements🧦[/h3]
There are several achievements are available for this update including the hidden one. Check them out!

notes.title: UX Update
notes.content:
[h3]Handheld Menu[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491378/91a199cb898a52d3389e3528e1b25547e339639c.jpg[/img]
Many players of different VR headsets had difficulty entering the game menu. Now it is enough to touch the bracelet on the left with an empty right hand. Three objects will appear: a gear - [b]Settings[/b], a book - an [b]Encyclopedia[/b] and a bag - [b]Inventory[/b]. Just grab the right one.

[h3]Checkpoint system[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491378/deaae9181e1996ff0bafa4098252a5bd13515c9f.jpg[/img]
Checkpoints will respond faster. They used to light up after the player left them. Returning teleport now shows the name of the checkpoint it will take you to.

[h3]Critical damage [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42491378/b58a77dfaa68cf2fb2f1d5e9b9f6e918a1f653aa.jpg[/img]
Every fourth hit on an enemy spawns a mark in one of four possible places: head, lower back, left or right shoulder. Hitting it will cause instant death or dismemberment of limbs.

[h3]Revolver reload[/h3]
Sometimes if you started reloading a revolver and threw it away, the next time you picked it up, its UI would show it was reloaded, which wasn't true. Not anymore.

[h3]Undead Officer Chest[/h3]
We fixed a bug that allowed opening an Undead Officer chest before killing its owner.

[h3]Natural holding and throwing[/h3]
You asked for it. You can now switch between two weapon holding modes. Our old mode required you to press the grab button to pick up the weapon and press it again to release it. In [b]natural mode[/b], you pick up an item by holding down the grab button. Releasing the button will cause the item to be thrown.

[h3]Monster Perception[/h3]
We have changed how monsters react to player actions. Now they will try to investigate the source of the sound instead of going on the attack.

[h3]Diehard mushrooms[/h3]
Some exploding mushrooms could not be detonated from a distance. They hid in the invisible walls of the environment. We have tried to correct this injustice.

[h3]Climbing update[/h3]
We noticed that trying to go down the ladders or mushrooms sometimes just didn't work. Fixed.

[h3]Healing Crystal and Stone of Life[/h3]
These two entities scattered particles around them very beautifully. But sometimes they did it spontaneously. They ask for forgiveness and won't do it again.

[h3]Halloween 🎃[/h3]
Tracery of Fate game is a dark fantasy so we decided to enhance it with even more creepiness due to Halloween eve. Now lower level skeletons will have pumpkin on their heads. Also watch out for the pumpkins among the bushes, they can explode when you approach!

If you don't have our game yet feel free to check out our DEMO version and [b]take a Halloween 50% discount (starting 25th of October)[/b]!

New location in Bastion is available for you now. Do you want to try your build? Go ahead! We are balancing the difficulty of the arena so please let us know if you manage to win it. (Don't forget to upgrade your skills if it's too tough for you).

Your primary weapon - an axe will no longer go through your enemy undetected. Come on, hit it again!

[h3]Sound overhaul 🎵[/h3]
Many sounds were replaced and now we have music for you to listen. More to come next time.

It's pretty boring to find the same bag of gold in most chests. Now there are several treasure items that will convert to gold coins upon pick up.

We've implemented unstuck system for your enemies. Let's see if this will help them not to get stuck forever in obstacles.

[h3]Finishers 💀[/h3]
Several new finishers were also added in this build.

[h3]Exchange consumables 💣[/h3]
Now you can finally give something to your companion. Revolver ammo or a healing potion, for example.

We continue to make HLODs and apply other techniques to improve game optimization.

notes.title: Hotfix for type change action
notes.content:
Thanks to your timely feedback, we were able to detect a small glitch that did not allow you to change the type of consumables held in the hand.

For a revolver, this action changes the type of bullets from ordinary to incendiary or freezing. Unless, of course, you have already managed to find the appropriate schematics and upgrade the pouches.

The same action switches your carried potions or bombs with mines.

These are the [b]X[/b] and [b]A[/b] buttons on most virtual reality controllers.

[h2]Other known bugs must be fixed later[/h2]
[list]
[*] Disappearing loot. As soon as you collect items (soul crystals, gold, relics, keys, etc.), they should appear in your Personal Inventory, i.e. Pockets. Sometimes it doesn't happen. However, as soon as you visit the Sentinel Stronghold, all those "lost" items will correctly appear in Shared Storage inventory.
[*]Widgets are not working. Sometimes, when you are teleported to the Sentinel Stronghold, screens like the Save menu stop working. It is enough to leave the doors of the Sentinel Stronghold and return back, this will fix the screens activity.[/list]

Sign Narva

notes.title: Patch #001
notes.content:
Patch notes

Dear Sentinels we hear your suffering. That's why we not only fixed some bugs and did some optimization, but also implemented several new features.

[b]New checkpoint system[/b]
Ancient devices that serve as checkpoints for Sentinels are scattered throughout the Ancient Vale and the city of Deia. They are activated by passing by the client player and the server player, independently of each other. Then you can choose to teleport from the Sentinel Stronghold to the last checkpoint visited.

[b]Simplified climbing[/b]
You can enable this mode to be teleported up as soon as you grab the climbing object or down as you grab the edge of the cliff.

[b]Seated mode[/b]
You can play in Seated mode now. Please enable it in the Settings menu. And don't forget to repeat the calibration procedure.

[b]I can see ghosts[/b]
You do not need to touch your bracelet to recall the Spirit companion. He will be visible in every location.

[b]Get a hint[/b]
All quest objects are now highlighted. However you can disable this option in the Settings menu.

[b]The Doors[/b]
Sentinel Stronghold door status replicates correctly from Server to the Client now.

[i][b]Unfortunately it is strongly recommended to start new game instead of loading.[/b][/i]

Sign Narva

notes.title: First patch is on the way
notes.content:
Dear Sentinels,

It's hard to find the right words to describe how glad we are of your interest and all those comments you sent to us in private or on the public boards. Thank you!

We are closely following your comments. That's why on the 12. Aug 2022 we are planning our first update. We tweaked ingame climbing system making it easier to get where you want to. 

* Game optimization
* Seated mode will be returned.
* Simplified climbing will actually work.
* Normal climbing final stage redesigned.
* Several quest items and puzzles were missing their highlight effect
* Fixed portcullis server to client replication issues

We are also working on reducing the downtime you have while going back to the place where your character died.

Sign Narva
